definition.comparison: every intermediate estimate is compared with its own final generated endpoint
definition.conditioning_limit: early stabilization is necessary but not sufficient for useful conditioning; causal utility requires a context intervention
definition.paired_noise: each run resets the same RNG seed and therefore starts from the same standardized Gaussian tensor; different learned coordinate systems do not imply paired semantic samples
definition.predicted_clean: z_hat = z_state + (1-path_time) * v_theta(z_state,path_time), applied per token for rational paths
definition.radial_metric: complex Fourier correlation and relative error preserve phase as well as power
